title: Anthropology, B.A. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Built from the archived 2024-25 bulletin's own Suggested Academic Plan and Program Requirements tabs (verified via direct HTML <table> parsing, cross-checked against its own printed semester subtotals: 16/16/16/16/15/15/13.5/13.5 = 121, matching the page's own 'Total Credits 121'). Entrance to major requires a 2.00 GPA and third-semester classification, not modeled directly (identical language to 2022-2026). Same judgment call as every other ANTH year: Fall Semester 1 modeled as literal ANTH 45N (not a pool) since Spring Semester 2 separately requires ANTH 21 specifically. STAT 200's real 'Enforced Prerequisite at Enrollment: Placement into MATH 21 or higher' confirmed present, word-for-word identical, on the archived 2024-25 STAT course-description page -- same real hidden-prereq chain as every other ANTH year: MATH 3 (Semester 1), MATH 4 (Semester 2), MATH 21 (Semester 3), adding 9cr beyond the bulletin's own stated 121cr total, documented rather than silently absorbed. Fits within max_credits_per_semester (18). REAL CHANGE FROM 2022/2023 FOUND: the Suggested Academic Plan's Fall/Spring structure and per-term credit totals are byte-identical to 2022-23/2023-24 (confirmed via archive diff: only cosmetic label rename 'Elective/Other Cultures' -> 'Elective/World Cultures', matching the Bulletin-wide 'foreign language' -> 'world language' terminology shift also seen in the Program Requirements text) -- so this year's plan still has NO LA 83/LA 283 seminar courses (those first appear starting 2025-26's edition) and keeps the same simpler First-Year structure (World Language Level 1 explicit in Semester 1, flexible GEN ED-or-First-Year-Seminar slot). REAL CHANGE IN THE METHODS COURSES POOL, confirmed via archive diff against 2023-24: ANTH 421, ANTH 429, and ANTH 431 were dropped from the bulletin's own 'Methods Courses' enumerated pool starting this 2024-25 edition (present in 2022-23 and 2023-24, absent here and in 2025-26/2026-27) -- this pool now reads ANTH 321W, 380, 410, 411, 425, 426W, 427W, 428, 432, 458, 492, 493, matching the current 2026 live bulletin's pool exactly. Modeled the 'ANTH Methods Course' slot as this real 2024-25 pool minus dead-catalog ANTH 380 (same reasoning as 2026's own notes: confirmed absent from anth_catalog.json) and minus ANTH 426W/427W (already required separately), leaving ANTH 321W, 410, 411, 425, 428, 432, 458, 492, 493 -- identical to the 2026 baseline's own Methods pool. Program Requirements summary table also shows Electives=18 for the first time this year (down from 21 in 2022-23/2023-24), matching 2025-26 and the current 2026 live page -- bookkeeping category only, not 1:1 modeled by this plan's own Elective-slot count (same as the 2026 baseline). Advanced Theory and Method course ranges and the Area/Survey Courses exclusion rule confirmed word-for-word identical to every other year -- reused the same match regexes as ANTH-2026.json.
